eli: Quick heads-up — all-hands next Tue 10:00 PT (link in calendar): agenda below. Please drop Qs here or DM me. Recording link will be posted after.

eli: Agenda (30m exec updates, 20m product demo, 10m security/compliance, 10m Q&A)

ingrid: Can we add a 5m slide about Dedicated capacity pricing changes? cc @olivia

eli: yes — added after exec updates. thanks.

sam: I can demo the batching dashboard, need a 10-min slot.

eli: perfect, slotting you into product demo.

tess: Is there a preferred format for Qs? bullet list or live during Q&A?

eli: drop bullet Qs here if you want them addressed in advance. live ok too.

maria: Q: will the Dedicated SLA changes affect current reserved contracts?

security: Q for security team: any update on SOC2 timeline?

eli: short answers: dedicated contracts unaffected — product will share opt-in migration plan. security will give SOC2 status in the compliance segment.

dev-bot: Reminder: calendar invite sent to all-hands@redwood.com — attendees: 120+

ingrid: Also want to surface a short ops postmortem summary from last week's gateway incident, 2 slides max.

eli: good call, adding postmortem highlights to ops section.

sam: Can we record the demo at high-res for the docs team?

eli: yes — recording + high-res export will be uploaded.

olivia: Thanks team — I'll do a 6-min exec note about strategy and hiring priorities, and call out new APAC region plan.

eli: friendly reminder: add your questions by EOD Fri so presenters can prep. :calendar: :thumbsup:

maria: submitting Q: migration path and timeline for model quantization options across Dedicated/Private.

security: submitting Q: KMS/HSM integrations — will customer-managed keys be supported in Private GA?

eli: Noted.

--- (post-meeting updates) ---

eli: Recording: https://redwood.zoom.us/rec/share/abc123-def456 (internal only)

eli: Slides + minutes: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/all-hands/1955554321-summary.pdf

olivia: Top takeaways: 1) APAC region plan on track Q3->Q4, 2) no forced contract migration, opt-in tooling available, 3) SOC2 timeline moved to 'in-review' target end of Q3.

ingrid: Ops takeaway: gateway incident root cause was autoscaler race condition; mitigations deployed — details in postmortem doc.

sam: Demo artifact: /docs/batching-dashboard/recording-1955554321.mp4

maria: Follow-ups: product to publish migration guide, security to confirm KMS roadmap by next Wed.

eli: Thanks everyone — closing thread. :raised_hands:
